legend: a cell is "<vendor event> <decisions> / <Observer>". Decisions: D deny, A ask,
M modify input, C inject context, U user-visible message, O observe only. Observer: W wired
(registered and a feature acts on it), R registered and captured only, probe (documented,
wire shape unverified), - not registered (vendor surface only). +manual = the mechanism is
never auto-registered. Generated from the registry's hook bindings (internal/integration);
`observer doctor --hooks <tool>` checks each binding on this machine (registered / trusted /
probe), and `observer doctor --probe-hook <tool>` fires a synthetic call through each wired gate.
